import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[8]; p=params[9]
    base=params[0]+params[1]*x+params[2]*x**3+params[3]*v+params[4]*v*np.abs(v)
    drive=np.cos(w*t+p)*(params[5]+params[6]*x+params[7]*v)
    return base+drive
